purpose: Focused fixture describing trust metadata persistence and reload equivalence cases.

persistenceDesign.historyExposure: getConversationMessages returns message.trust copied from metadata.trust when it is a JSON object
persistenceDesign.legacyBehavior: old or malformed messages return trust:null
persistenceDesign.futureFieldBehavior: unknown future JSON fields are preserved at persistence boundaries; frontend presentation safely normalizes unknown enums
